title: A proximal gradient method with adaptive backtracking for weakly smooth multiobjective optimization
summary: In this paper, we propose a proximal gradient method with adaptive linesearch for multiobjective optimization problems whose objective functions are weakly smooth, i.e., they have Hölder continuous gradients. The proposed method is parameter-free as we do not require prior knowledge of parameters related to the weak smoothness of the objective function; the proposed linesearch finds an appropriate step-size that adapts to the weak smoothness.
